kpis.description_fr: Dominion Virginia = utility électrique réglementée Virginie. Plus gros segment Dominion. Tailwind data center cloud (AWS Northern Virginia).
kpis.description_en: Dominion Virginia = regulated VA electric utility. Dominion's largest segment. Data center tailwind (AWS Northern Virginia).

kpis.description_fr: Dominion South Carolina = utility électrique réglementée SC (ex-SCANA). Plus stable que Virginia.
kpis.description_en: Dominion South Carolina = regulated SC electric utility (ex-SCANA). More stable than Virginia.

kpis.description_fr: Demande électrique data centers Northern Virginia. Cluster #1 mondial. Croissance explosive IA. ~21 % de la load Dominion.
kpis.description_en: Northern Virginia data center electricity demand. World's #1 data center cluster. Explosive AI growth. ~21% of Dominion load.

kpis.description_fr: Capacité renouvelables (solaire surtout) installée. Plan Virginia Clean Economy Act 100 % zéro-carbone d'ici 2045.
kpis.description_en: Renewable capacity (mainly solar) installed. Virginia Clean Economy Act plan: 100% zero-carbon by 2045.

kpis.description_fr: Projet CVOW = ~2,6 GW offshore wind Virginia Beach. Mise en service prévue 2026-27. Plus gros offshore wind USA.
kpis.description_en: CVOW project = ~2.6 GW offshore wind Virginia Beach. Targeted 2026-27 commissioning. Largest US offshore wind.
